characters.name: MÄGER MATS
characters.description: Väike hall mäger mustade triipudega näol, kandmas väikest sinist vesti, suured sõbralikud silmad ja naeratav suu. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: SIIL SASS
characters.description: Väike pruun siil pehmete okastega, kandmas väikest rohelist salli, uudishimulik nina ja rõõmus näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Mäger Matsi hubane tuba
locations.description: Cozy children's room with light green walls, a light wooden floor, and a single window on the back wall showing bright green spring trees. A small round wooden table is in the center, with two small wooden chairs. A simple wooden bookshelf with a few colorful books is on the left wall. Warm, inviting atmosphere. Cartoon style.

locations.name: Päikeseline niit
locations.description: Wide open sunny meadow with vibrant green grass and a few small, colorful wildflowers scattered around. In the distance, gentle rolling hills under a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds. A light, gentle breeze is subtly visible. Cheerful and expansive atmosphere. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Mäger Mats and Siil Sass are sitting on small wooden chairs at a small round wooden table in Mats's cozy room. Mats is holding a finger to his chin, deep in thought. Sass is looking at Mats with curious eyes, also appearing thoughtful. The room has light green walls, a light wooden floor, a window showing spring trees, and a wooden bookshelf on the left. Cartoon style.

Mäger Mats and Siil Sass are still sitting at the small round wooden table. Mats now has a bright, happy expression, pointing a finger upwards as if having an idea. Sass is smiling widely, looking at Mats with excitement. The room has light green walls, a light wooden floor, a window showing spring trees, and a wooden bookshelf on the left. Cartoon style.

Mäger Mats and Siil Sass are enthusiastically pointing towards an imaginary sky, both smiling broadly. On the small round wooden table in front of them, a stack of colorful paper and some craft supplies (like a glue stick and child-safe scissors) are now visible. The room has light green walls, a light wooden floor, a window showing spring trees, and a wooden bookshelf on the left. Cartoon style.

Colorful craft paper in various bright colors (red, yellow, blue, green) is spread out on the small round wooden table. Mäger Mats and Siil Sass are both looking at the paper with focused, happy expressions. Mats is picking up a sheet of blue paper, and Sass is touching a yellow sheet with a paw. The room has light green walls, a light wooden floor, a window showing spring trees, and a wooden bookshelf on the left. Cartoon style.

Mäger Mats and Siil Sass are actively crafting at the small round wooden table. Mats is carefully cutting a piece of colorful paper with child-safe scissors. Sass is holding a glue stick and applying glue to another piece of paper. Several partially assembled kite pieces are on the table. The room has light green walls, a light wooden floor, a window showing spring trees, and a wooden bookshelf on the left. Cartoon style.

Two beautifully finished, colorful kites are displayed prominently on the small round wooden table. One kite is predominantly blue and red, the other yellow and green. Mäger Mats and Siil Sass are standing next to the table, admiring their creations with proud, happy smiles. The room has light green walls, a light wooden floor, a window showing spring trees, and a wooden bookshelf on the left. Cartoon style.

Mäger Mats and Siil Sass are walking side-by-side through a vibrant green meadow. Mats is carrying the blue and red kite, and Sass is carrying the yellow and green kite. Both are looking ahead with eager, joyful expressions. The meadow has colorful wildflowers, gentle rolling hills in the distance, and a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style.

Mäger Mats and Siil Sass are in the middle of the sunny meadow. Mats is holding his blue and red kite high, and the kite's tail is gently fluttering in the wind. Sass is standing beside him, holding his yellow and green kite, also showing a slight movement from the wind. Both characters are looking up at the sky, smiling as if feeling the breeze. The meadow has colorful wildflowers, gentle rolling hills in the distance, and a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style.

Both the blue and red kite (held by Mats) and the yellow and green kite (held by Sass) are flying high in the bright blue sky above the meadow. Mats and Sass are standing below, looking up with amazement and delight, their arms slightly extended as if holding the kite strings (which are implied). The meadow has colorful wildflowers, gentle rolling hills in the distance, and a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style.

Mäger Mats and Siil Sass are sitting happily on the vibrant green grass in the meadow, looking up at their two colorful kites still flying high in the sky. Mats has an arm around Sass in a friendly gesture. Both are beaming with joy and satisfaction. The meadow has colorful wildflowers, gentle rolling hills in the distance, and a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style.
